---
title: "Statistical Animation Gallery"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
    css: style.css
---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, results="asis", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
```

<div class="header">
  <h1>?? Animation Gallery</h1>
  <p>Interactive Statistical Visualizations with Animint2</p>
</div>
```{r stats}
meta <- fread("meta.csv")
cat(sprintf('
<div class="stats-box">
  <p class="stats-number">%d</p>
  <p class="stats-label">Interactive Visualizations</p>
</div>
', nrow(meta)))
```

<div class="viz-grid">
```{r gallery}
for(i in 1:nrow(meta)) {
  row <- meta[i,]
  img_path <- sprintf("repos/%s.png", gsub("/", "_", row$viz_owner_repo))
  viz_url <- sprintf("https://%s.github.io/%s/", 
                     sub("/.*", "", row$viz_owner_repo),
                     sub(".*/", "", row$viz_owner_repo))
  repo_url <- sprintf("https://github.com/%s", row$viz_owner_repo)
  
  cat(sprintf('
<div class="viz-card">
  <a href="%s" target="_blank">
    <img src="%s" class="viz-image" alt="%s"/>
  </a>
  <div class="viz-content">
    <h3 class="viz-title">%s</h3>
    <div class="viz-links">
      <a href="%s" target="_blank">?? View Live</a>
      <a href="%s" target="_blank">?? Repository</a>
      <a href="%s" target="_blank">?? Source Code</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
', viz_url, img_path, row$title, row$title, viz_url, repo_url, row$source))
}
```

</div>

<div class="footer">
  <p>Built with ❤️ using <a href="https://github.com/animint/animint2" style="color: #667eea;">animint2</a></p>

</div>
